findings.issue: explain's fallback still shows a stored verdict past the check: when pending_still_applies drops a moved gate-red (gate_basis_holds False) the loop falls through to read_explain(), which prints the last signal's kept text - the same stale 'recorded gate red ... run X' line the check just discarded. The task asks for ONE check every display path goes through; this path is guarded for the live decision but not for its kept copy. No sv case drives explain over a moved decision.
findings.resolution: In explain, when a pending for the subject exists and verdict_moved(ctx, pending) is not None, answer that the decision was discarded (its note) instead of falling back to the kept text, and add a case that changes buildCommands and asks explain.

findings.issue: The _RUN_ID widening ([^\s;]+) is outside the task's description and changes what green_phase_gate stores at :5439 as phaseGate.runId (previously '<id>;' on the terse green line, which could never match a row, so held-gate reuse silently never fired). Phase-gate reuse can now fire where it did not; the executor says so in its outcome but no case pins either the new reuse or its binding by held_gate_binds.
findings.resolution: Add a case that a green phase gate's terse line yields a held runId that names a ledger row and that held_gate_binds still refuses when head or the gate moved; or split the regex fix into its own task.

findings.issue: tree_key is now a second spelling of plugins/audit/scripts/governance/run-test-gate.py:5062 tree_key, held equal only by sv7. A change to either spelling that sv7 cannot see (e.g. a different realpath policy) makes every wave member's stored verdict compare MOVED and be re-measured for ever.
findings.resolution: Make run-test-gate delegate to _evidence_io.tree_key in its own task, as the executor's note proposes, and keep sv7 as the pin until then.

findings.issue: rerun_alongside reaches a parked member only when its failing-step list equals the answered member's (sorted ==). The task clause says every member 'whose pending red carries the same failing step'; a member red on {unit-a, unit-b} beside one red on {unit-a} is not reached. It is asked for its own answer rather than silently replayed (the clause's alternative), so this is a narrowing, not a replay.
findings.resolution: Either reach members whose failing set intersects the answered one, or state in the docstring/outcome that the rule is set equality and why.
